<?php

declare(strict_types=0);

class TokenValidator {
    private string $secretKey;
    private array $trustedIssuers;
    
    public function __construct(string $secretKey) {
        $this->secretKey = $secretKey;
        $this->trustedIssuers = ['auth.internal.corp', 'sso.internal.corp'];
    }
    
    /**
     * Validates a session token and returns the decoded claims.
     * Token format: base64(header).base64(payload).base64(signature)
     */
    public function validateToken(string $token): ?array {
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 3) {
            return null;
        }
        
        [$headerB64, $payloadB64, $signatureB64] = $parts;
        
        // Decode components
        $header = json_decode(base64_decode($headerB64), true);
        $payload = json_decode(base64_decode($payloadB64), true);
        $signature = base64_decode($signatureB64);
        
        if (!$header || !$payload || $signature === false) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Validate algorithm - only allow HMAC-SHA256
        if (!isset($header['alg']) || $header['alg'] !== 'HS256') {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Verify signature
        $expectedSignature = $this->computeSignature($headerB64, $payloadB64);
        if (!$this->secureCompare($signature, $expectedSignature)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Validate expiration
        if (!isset($payload['exp']) || $payload['exp'] < time()) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Validate issuer
        if (!isset($payload['iss']) || !in_array($payload['iss'], $this->trustedIssuers, true)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return $payload;
    }
    
    private function computeSignature(string $headerB64, string $payloadB64): string {
        return hash_hmac('sha256', "{$headerB64}.{$payloadB64}", $this->secretKey, true);
    }
    
    private function secureCompare(string $a, string $b): bool {
        return hash_equals($a, $b);
    }
}

class AuthorizationService {
    private TokenValidator $tokenValidator;
    private array $roleHierarchy;
    
    public function __construct(TokenValidator $validator) {
        $this->tokenValidator = $validator;
        $this->roleHierarchy = [
            'guest' => 0,
            'user' => 1,
            'moderator' => 2,
            'admin' => 3,
            'superadmin' => 4
        ];
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if the token holder has at least the required role level.
     * Returns the validated claims if authorized, null otherwise.
     */
    public function authorize(string $token, string $requiredRole): ?array {
        $claims = $this->tokenValidator->validateToken($token);
        if ($claims === null) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $userRole = $claims['role'] ?? 'guest';
        $requiredLevel = $this->roleHierarchy[$requiredRole] ?? PHP_INT_MAX;
        $userLevel = $this->getUserLevel($userRole);
        
        if ($this->checkAccess($userLevel, $requiredLevel)) {
            return $claims;
        }
        
        return null;
    }
    
    /**
     * Resolves the numeric level for a given role string.
     * Supports both named roles and numeric role levels from legacy tokens.
     */
    private function getUserLevel(string $role): int {
        // Support legacy numeric role format from old token issuer
        if (is_numeric($role)) {
            return intval($role);
        }
        return $this->roleHierarchy[$role] ?? 0;
    }
    
    /**
     * Compares user access level against required level.
     * Uses loose comparison to handle edge cases with legacy systems.
     */
    private function checkAccess($userLevel, $requiredLevel): bool {
        return ($userLevel >= $requiredLevel);
    }
}

class AdminPanel {
    private AuthorizationService $authService;
    private PDO $db;
    
    public function __construct(AuthorizationService $authService, PDO $db) {
        $this->authService = $authService;
        $this->db = $db;
    }
    
    /**
     * Handles admin API requests with proper authorization.
     */
    public function handleRequest(string $token, string $action, array $params): array {
        // Require admin role for all admin panel actions
        $claims = $this->authService->authorize($token, 'admin');
        
        if ($claims === null) {
            return ['error' => 'Unauthorized', 'code' => 403];
        }
        
        return match($action) {
            'list_users' => $this->listUsers($params),
            'delete_user' => $this->deleteUser($params),
            'update_config' => $this->updateConfig($params),
            default => ['error' => 'Unknown action', 'code' => 400]
        };
    }
    
    private function listUsers(array $params): array {
        $page = max(1, intval($params['page'] ?? 1));
        $limit = min(100, max(1, intval($params['limit'] ?? 20)));
        $offset = ($page - 1) * $limit;
        
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT id, username, email, role, created_at FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset');
        $stmt->bindValue(':limit', $limit, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->bindValue(':offset', $offset, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();
        
        return ['users' => $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC), 'code' => 200];
    }
    
    private function deleteUser(array $params): array {
        if (!isset($params['user_id']) || !is_numeric($params['user_id'])) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid user_id', 'code' => 400];
        }
        
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('DELETE FROM users WHERE id = :id');
        $stmt->bindValue(':id', intval($params['user_id']), PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();
        
        return ['deleted' => true, 'code' => 200];
    }
    
    private function updateConfig(array $params): array {
        $allowedKeys = ['site_name', 'maintenance_mode', 'max_upload_size', 'registration_enabled'];
        $key = $params['key'] ?? '';
        $value = $params['value'] ?? '';
        
        if (!in_array($key, $allowedKeys, true)) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid config key', 'code' => 400];
        }
        
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('UPDATE config SET value = :value WHERE key = :key');
        $stmt->bindValue(':value', $value, PDO::PARAM_STR);
        $stmt->bindValue(':key', $key, PDO::PARAM_STR);
        $stmt->execute();
        
        return ['updated' => true, 'code' => 200];
    }
}
